note.explanation: AI is a field of computer science that enables computer systems to simulate human thinking and learning. Its uses include healthcare, education, gaming, transportation, and farming.
note.checkAnswer: Machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and robotics.
note.simple: AI helps computers do tasks that seem to need human thinking, such as understanding a question or recognizing a picture.

Incorrect: connecting devices describes the Internet of Things, not AI.

Incorrect: storing files is not the definition of AI.

John McCarthy in 2023

rationales: Correct: the section says John McCarthy first invented the term AI in 1956 during the Dartmouth Conference.
Incorrect: the section dates the Dartmouth Conference to 1956, not 1966.
Incorrect: 1997 is the year of the Deep Blue chess milestone, not the naming of AI.
Incorrect: 2023 is associated with ChatGPT, not the first use of the term AI.

written.text: What is the historical context and evolution of AI?
written.finalAnswer: The term AI was first invented by John McCarthy in 1956 during the Dartmouth Conference. Early AI research focused on problem-solving and symbolic methods in the 1950s–1960s; expert systems developed in the 1970s–1980s; machine learning rose in the 1990s; and deep learning, NLP, and robotics advanced from the 2000s onward. Voice assistants were used in 2011, and ChatGPT was introduced in 2023.

Expert systems developed in the 1970s–1980s, and machine learning rose in the 1990s.
From the 2000s onward, deep learning, natural language processing, and robotics expanded AI's capabilities.
Voice assistants were used in 2011, and ChatGPT was introduced in 2023.

examTips: A short question may ask you to define AI; learn the textbook definition accurately.
For a history question, give the 1956 Dartmouth Conference and John McCarthy, then list milestones in date order.
A short application question may ask for two examples from one domain. Give two distinct uses, not two versions of the same use.
A long question about education should name the applications and explain their benefits, rather than only listing them.
For full marks, use the subject terms from your textbook, such as personalized learning, administrative tasks, and student performance.

explain.title: What is AI?
explain.body: Artificial Intelligence denotes the simulation of human thinking ability in computer systems to think and learn in a manner like humans. In simple terms, AI lets computer systems carry out tasks that seem to need human thinking.

explain.title: How did AI develop?
explain.body: The term AI was first invented by John McCarthy in 1956 during the Dartmouth Conference. Early work focused on problem-solving and symbolic methods. Expert systems followed, then machine learning rose in the 1990s. From the 2000s onward, deep learning, NLP, and robotics expanded AI's capabilities.

explain.title: Where is AI used?
explain.body: AI is used in areas such as healthcare, education, gaming, transportation, finance, social media, agriculture, and e-commerce. For example, healthcare systems can help diagnose diseases, personalize treatment plans, and predict patient outcomes.

explain.title: What are the subfields of AI?
explain.body: Machine learning enables computers to learn from experience and improve over time without being explicitly programmed. Deep learning is a special kind of machine learning using neural networks. NLP helps computers understand and use human language. Computer vision helps computers interpret images and videos. Robotics is the science of building and programming robots.

mistakes: Do not confuse AI with the Internet of Things; AI simulates human thinking, while IoT connects devices and systems.
Do not say John McCarthy created the first AI program: the section says he invented the term AI in 1956, while the Logic Theorist was created in 1955 by Allen Newell and Herbert A. Simon.
Do not mix up NLP and computer vision: NLP concerns language, while computer vision concerns images and videos.
When giving examples, make sure they belong to the domain asked about; for healthcare, use diagnosis, personalized treatment, or patient-outcome prediction.
In a history answer, keep dates and developments in chronological order.
